note: As of 2026-07-11 (issue #18) this repo holds the real component source under components/** (pulled from the Claude Design project) plus tokens/, styles.css, and the hand-authored ui_kits/tidepool-webui/**. _ds_bundle.js is built locally from components/** via `node scripts/build-ds-bundle.mjs` — not by the design-sync skill's own converter, which still must not be run against this repo (it expects a real npm package entry, which this repo doesn't have). Component fixes may be made here (edit components/**, rebuild, optionally push the changed file(s) up via DesignSync write_files) or in the Claude Design project (DesignSync write_files, then pull the changed file(s) down with DesignSync get_file and rebuild) — either way stays inside one session. ui_kits/tidepool-webui/** keeps its own separate rule: this repo is its only source, so sync stays write-back only (push local edits up after every kit change). See .design-sync/NOTES.md for the 2026-07-11 history.
